messages:
elaine: kicking off onboarding for caligo12b (decoder-only, 12b). goal: get baseline perf + quick quant smoke and a ctx/batch sweep for SLOs. can folks prioritize this week?

sam: on it. what targets are we using for 1k token ctx at p50/p95?

elaine: target p50 < 90ms/token and p95 < 180ms/token on dedicated A100-80GB. throughput target 2.5k tok/s for batch=8 at 1k ctx.

cheng: copying checklist i usually run: 1) smoke perf (cpu/gpu) 2) ctx sweep 512/1k/2k/4k 3) batch sweep [1,4,8,16] 4) int8 + int4 quant smoke 5) eval-set regression (convQA-v1 + summarization-small) 6) kv-cache warmup tests 7) fallback variant perf.

rachel: i'll run the convQA evals and quality diffs. which quant tool? bitsandbytes int8?

elaine: yes bnb-int8 for first-pass. try int4 with the new quant-lite pipeline but treat as exploratory. record perplexity, exact-match, and any changed logits on safety tokens.

marco: perf-bot started a smoke job: see logs.

perf-bot: CI smoke for caligo12b: commit c3f2b7. env: a100-80. batch=1 ctx=1024 seq=1024. results: p50=96ms/tok, p95=175ms/tok, throughput=1.04k tok/s. kv-cache cold add ~18ms overhead first token.

sam: ok p50 slightly above 90ms. maybe kernel selection wrong. i'll try async-batching + attn-tiling flags.

sam: running batch sweep now. cmd: ```./bench --model caligo12b --device gpu --ctx 1024 --batches 1,4,8,16 --measure latency,throughput --warmup 20 --iters 200```

perf-bot: batch sweep results (1024 ctx): batch=1 -> 1.05k tok/s p95=175ms; batch=4 -> 2.3k tok/s p95=210ms; batch=8 -> 3.8k tok/s p95=340ms; batch=16 -> 4.7k tok/s p95=620ms. recommendation: cap batch at 8 for throughput but p95 exceeds SLO; use batch=4 for p95 safety.

cheng: that's expected. avg token size and prompt shape for our evals is small, so continuous batching helps tail but hurts p95. try prefix caching and small-batch multiplexing.

rachel: convQA eval (baseline fp16): EM=72.8, F1=84.5, ppl (wikitext) = 12.4. int8 quick-run: EM=71.9 (-0.9), F1=83.9 (-0.6), ppl=13.1. int4 exploratory: EM=68.0 (-4.8) -> probably a regression, keep in experimental.

elaine: record thresholds: >2% EM drop flags a regression. int8 is within 1.5% so ok for now but mark for longer eval. int4 fails gating.

sam: did cache warmup run: cold->hot delta for 2k ctx is ~24% faster after first seq. script: ```./warmup --model caligo12b --prompt-file smallprompts.txt --iters 50```

marco: perf-bot added a ctx sweep: 512/1024/2048/4096 with batch=4. results: 512 p50=60ms tok; 1024=95ms; 2048=150ms; 4096=340ms. throughput scaling flattens after 2k.

cheng: notes for optimization: 1) try fused rotary kernels, 2) reduce kv mem copies, 3) examine kernel choice for cross-attention fallback (if any).

rachel: logging a quick regression ticket for int4 experiments (ML-EVAL-338). linking eval diffs and sample failures.

elaine: next actions: @sam try attn-tiling + fused rotary tomorrow and re-run 1k ctx batch=4. @cheng run int8 full eval (all datasets) and produce a qualitative diff doc. @rachel extend convQA to conversational long-turns. i'll update onboarding doc with recommended default config: fp16 for hosted, int8 allowed for Dedicated with caveats, batch_default=4, max_batch=8 but p95 guard rails.

sam: ack. i'll post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: perf artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-ci/caligo12b/3339876543/artifacts.tar.gz

marco: thanks all — great first pass. closing loop after sam's re-run. :eyes:
